branch_derivations.reasoning: Approved L3/L10 F05 and L4 prose establish that Ref comparison checks identity/revision/scope/owner (and supplied digest) without using source_locator as identity, and that insufficient supply yields matching=unestablished while preserving all candidate occurrences. However, L4 prose explicitly leaves the detailed private types, guards, branches, and leaf writers to L5/L8 (/field_semantic_evidence_contract/detail_and_consumer_boundary/0). Specifically, when matching=unestablished occurs during F05 operand lookup across axis_facts and semantic_records, L4 prose does not uniquely determine: (1) whether the Cause.kind is content_unresolved vs target_unformed/target_mismatch, (2) whether Cause.left and Cause.right hold the whole Ref/record Reads, the specific unestablished sub-field Reads (identity/revision/scope/owner/sha256), or the collection Reads, and (3) whether one Cause is emitted per operand_ref, per candidate occurrence, or per unestablished axis. Following the rule to advance only branches uniquely determined from upstream and leave undetermined branches in STOP with recorded basis, branch (a) must remain in STOP-F05-CONTENT-UNRESOLVED-CAUSE-PAIR-01.

local_cause_kind.outer_or_operand_level_fact: L4 prose states that even for the same Ref, occurrences whose record binding/revision/scope differ must all be preserved (/field_source_materialization_contract/ordered_source_materialization/3) and that binding correspondence checks requirement_ref, product_scope, process_contract_ref, application_contract_ref, and template/knowledge/oracle refs (/field_semantic_evidence_contract/common_target_guards/1). If no corresponding record with matching binding resolves the operand, the operand is unresolved (content_unresolved at the definition evidence guard level), whereas a candidate record with matching Ref but different/unestablished binding could be classified as content_unresolved, target_mismatch, or target_unformed.

Therefore, branch (b) is not uniquely determined from L3/L10 + L4 prose alone and must remain in STOP-F05-CONTENT-UNRESOLVED-CAUSE-PAIR-01.

branch_derivations.reasoning: In /field_obligation_scope_contract/cause_patterns/content_unresolved, a single-collection lookup (unfinished_obligation_refs in raw.obligations) sets left = operand Ref Read and right = raw.obligations collection Read. By contrast, F05 field operand resolution searches TWO collections simultaneously: axis_facts and semantic_records (/field_source_materialization_contract/original_operand_contract/record_domain). When one or both of axis_facts and semantic_records are unobserved (absent/null/non-array/unreached), L4 prose does not uniquely determine: (1) whether the Cause.kind is content_unresolved, input_unobserved, or target_unformed/body_unformed, (2) which collection Read goes into Cause.right (since Cause has only one left and one right Operand) or whether two separate Causes are emitted (one for axis_facts and one for semantic_records), and (3) what happens when one collection is a valid array with no matching occurrence while the other collection is unobserved (whether 1 Cause for the unobserved collection or 2 Causes covering both collections are emitted). Therefore, branch (c) is not uniquely determined from L3/L10 + L4 prose alone and must remain in STOP-F05-CONTENT-UNRESOLVED-CAUSE-PAIR-01.
